dedupe_keys.name: autoapi xml to json service builder

description: autoAPI builds configurable JSON services from XML sources through a Python Flask application. Adrian Moore publishes a graphical workflow for selecting fields, renaming attributes, flattening structures and removing null values. Saved configurations can include parameterized source addresses, and the repository demonstrates transport station timetable information. Geographic coverage, observation period and refresh frequency remain properties of the selected upstream source. The software can prepare service and timetable inputs for related public transport simulations. Source code is free under MIT. A limitation is that it does not grant access to upstream data or guarantee that a source schema remains stable. Flattening and field selection can discard relationships needed by a model. Deployment also requires an appropriate server configuration. No hosted application was tested and no timetable query or user data upload was made.
name: autoAPI XML to JSON service builder
notes: G5 G5-0422. Software checked through metadata and documentation, without installation or execution. Geographic scope follows the documented application or software portability; it does not imply validation throughout that area.
